results.description:
No one does fiction like a reality TV show. 

When the crew of No Place Like Home arrives in Sinful to shoot an episode for the series, most of the locals are thrilled. After all, it’s a chance to showcase their town and maybe get some screen time. Fortune, Ida Belle, and Carter have their doubts that it’s going to be the wonderful event the others are predicting. 

But no one expected the lead actor to be murdered.
 
Now Hollywood reporters are descending on the tiny bayou town, and all cameras are pointed at Carter. Can Swamp Team 3 identify the killer before the credits roll and without the press causing irreparable damage to Carter’s reputation? They’re certainly going to try, but when the cast of suspects are not only strangers but professional liars, a quick take doesn’t appear to be in the script.
